name: YouTube Transcript
description: Fetches manually-created or automatic YouTube subtitles with yt-dlp (without downloading the video), saves a timestamped transcript to a text file, and returns only its path to the calling agent.

commands.title: Get YouTube transcript
commands.description: Retrieve timestamped subtitles from a YouTube URL/video ID (or a prompt containing one). Optional language/languages input such as 'fa,en'; prefers a matching manually-created subtitle before automatic captions. Saves the full transcript as a text file and returns only its path so the agent can read relevant sections as needed.

config.label: Transcript output directory
config.description: Optional. Directory where full transcript files are saved. Defaults to ~/.mocu/youtube-transcripts.

config.label: yt-dlp executable path
config.description: Optional. Leave blank to use yt-dlp from PATH; on Windows you can enter the full path to yt-dlp.exe.
